recommendations.current_status: No ACE inhibitor or ARB documented
recommendations.guideline_requirement: ACE inhibitor or ARB first-line for Stage 4 CKD
recommendations.recommendation: Initiate ACE inhibitor (lisinopril 5-10mg daily) or ARB if ACE intolerant. Monitor creatinine and potassium.
recommendations.evidence: 30-39% kidney failure risk reduction, 18-24% CV event reduction
recommendations.monitoring: Recheck labs in 1-2 weeks after initiation

recommendations.recommendation: Continue current anemia management. Monitor iron stores regularly.
recommendations.monitoring: CBC every 3 months, iron studies every 6 months

recommendations.recommendation: Check 25(OH)D and replete if low. Consider calcitriol or paricalcitol if D/Ca/Phos normal. Evaluate phosphate binders.
Restrict phosphate-rich foods (dairy, cola, processed meats). Consider phosphate binders if serum phosphate elevated.

recommendations.guideline_requirement: Regular bicarbonate monitoring in Stage 4 CKD
recommendations.recommendation: Obtain serum bicarbonate level. If <22 mEq/L, initiate oral bicarbonate or base-producing diet.
Ensure regular nephrology follow-up every 2-3 months. Discuss RRT options and conservative care.
recommendations.evidence: Stage 4 is transition phase requiring specialist management
recommendations.monitoring: eGFR, albuminuria, progression rate every 2-3 months
recommendations.urgency: Schedule within 4-6 weeks if not established

recommendations.recommendation: Review all medications for dose adjustments (antibiotics, hypoglycemics, anticoagulants). Avoid NSAIDs and nephrotoxins.

recommendations.guideline_requirement: Plan vascular access when eGFR approaches 15
recommendations.recommendation: Begin dialysis access planning. Consider arteriovenous fistula creation. Evaluate for transplant candidacy.
